message.reasoning_content: Round 5 market, price 12+2=14 per unit. Sell all 3 now = 42 alashi cash. But round 6 devaluation: cash→floor/100*62, so holding cash loses 38%. Sell_credit gives promissory which is added to cash after devaluation — better! Promissory: sell 3 at credit = 14*3*1.25 = 52.5 alashi promissory, added in round 6 without devaluation. So sell_credit 3 units is best (unless law 8 zeroes promissory... risk). Law 8 already appeared round 3. So sell_credit units 3, choice 6.
